hotel.name: Novotel Danang Premier Han River
hotel.address: 36 Bach Dang, Hai Chau, Da Nang (Han River west bank — city/river, NOT beach)

tip: Only ~1.5–2 activity days: Ba Na full day Sat 26 + Dragon Bridge Fri/Sat (both fire-show nights). Asia Park & Helio market CLOSED/suspended — skip. Mikazuki OR Son Tra as flex half-day.

attractions.name: Ba Na Hills + Golden Bridge + Fantasy Park
attractions.shortDescription: Cable car, Golden Bridge hands, French Village, and indoor Fantasy Park — the #1 Da Nang ticket day.
attractions.whyKids: 8/9 love Fantasy Park; 12yo Alpine Coaster; fog common Sep–Feb but indoors saves the day.
attractions.reviewSummary: Hebrew + English family consensus ‘whole day.’ Weekend queues on Sat 26 — go early / WOW Pass if offered.
attractions.duration: Full day — do NOT combine with Mikazuki

attractions.name: Dragon Bridge fire & water show
attractions.shortDescription: Free dragon that breathes real fire ~21:00 Fri–Sun — your Fri 25 + Sat 26 are both show nights.

attractions.reviewSummary: KissTour + dananghotelguide staple; light rain usually OK, heavy storm may cancel.

attractions.name: VR Another World Danang (VR Another World Đà Nẵng)
attractions.shortDescription: Indoor free-roam VR arena on Trần Hưng Đạo (3F Salem Riverside) — solid rainy-day or evening option near central Da Nang.
attractions.whyKids: Immersive group VR games suit older kids (8–12); venue age 6+. Check height/comfort per game on site; staff guides first-timers.
attractions.reviewSummary: Official site ~4.3/5 (266); visitor blogs call it fun & good value. Tripadvisor Da Nang listing thin — book ahead for Xmas Fri–Sun slots.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: ~8–15 min Grab across Han River to An Hải / Sơn Trà (~2–4 km)
